# YOLOv7-s-face

Face Detection · `yolov7-s-face_640x640` · DX-APP Python example

Face Detection model, evaluated on WiderFace.

**Input** 640 × 640 × 3 · **Dataset** WiderFace · **License** GPL-3.0 · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![YOLOv7-s-face output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models YOLOv7s_Face
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/face_detection/yolov7_face/yolov7-s-face_640x640/yolov7-s-face_640x640_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolov7-s-face_640x640.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_face.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolov7-s-face_640x640_sync   # once
./bin/yolov7-s-face_640x640_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolov7-s-face_640x640.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_face.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | AP(Easy) | AP(Med) | AP(Hard) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 94.86 | 93.24 | 85.23 |
| Q-Lite | 94.89 (+0.03) | 93.28 (+0.04) | 85.21 (−0.02) |
| Q-Pro | 94.95 (+0.09) | 93.35 (+0.11) | 85.15 (−0.08) |

WiderFace · difference vs Raw in brackets.
